questions.question: If you realize you may be late to your destination, you should:

options.text: Speed up.
Get upset.
Accept it and drive safely.

questions.explanation: To avoid aggressive driving, manage your stress. Take a deep breath and accept that you will be late. Safe driving is more important than being on time.

questions.question: What prevents wheel lockup when braking?

options.text: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS)
Air brakes
An alternator

questions.explanation: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) prevents your wheels from locking up when you brake.

questions.question: Alcohol evaporators are:

options.text: Illegal.
Used to add alcohol to brake systems to prevent freezing.
Only allowed on vehicles carrying hazardous materials.

questions.correctAnswerText: Used to add alcohol to brake systems to prevent freezing.
questions.explanation: Some air brake systems have an alcohol evaporator. It adds alcohol to the brake system to prevent ice from forming and causing damage.

questions.question: An exhaust system should be:

options.text: Loose.
Leaking.
Fastened securely.

questions.explanation: The exhaust system must be properly mounted and secure. Parts should not be loose, broken, missing, or rubbing against other vehicle parts.

questions.question: After completing a pre-trip inspection, you should ensure that the:

options.text: Service line valve is closed.
Trailer hand brake is applied.
Emergency line valve is open.

questions.explanation: Before driving, open the emergency line and service line valves to check that air reaches all brakes. Listen for escaping air. Then close both valves before you start driving.

questions.question: Skids caused by speeding up too fast can usually be fixed by:

options.text: Removing your foot from the accelerator.
Braking.
Swerving to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Removing your foot from the accelerator.
questions.explanation: Remove your foot from the accelerator to stop a skid caused by speeding up too fast. This type of skid happens most often on snow or ice.

questions.question: A driver who stops at a green light could be:

options.text: An impaired driver.
A driver who is color blind.
A person who does not know the rules of the road.

questions.explanation: Watch other drivers for signs of impaired driving. Drivers who are drunk, tired, on drugs, or sick are dangerous. Stopping at a green light is a sign that a driver may be impaired.

questions.question: Mirror adjustment can only be checked properly if:

options.text: The trailer is straight.
There is no trailer.
The vehicle is on a slight incline.

questions.explanation: On vehicles with trailers, you can only check mirror adjustment correctly when the trailers are straight. Check mirrors before every trip.

questions.question: Within 10 minutes of stopping on the side of the road, you must:

options.text: Place emergency warning devices.
Alert local law enforcement.
Call a mechanic.

questions.explanation: If you stop on the side of the road, place emergency warning devices within 10 minutes.

questions.question: When starting a truck with a trailer, the ABS is not working if:

options.text: The yellow light on the left rear of the trailer stays on.
The red light on the right side of the trailer flashes three times.
All the rear lights flash and then turn off.

questions.correctAnswerText: The yellow light on the left rear of the trailer stays on.
questions.explanation: Dashboard lights should come on when you start the engine, then turn off. If the ABS warning light stays on, the system is not working. On a truck with a trailer, if the yellow light on the left rear of the trailer stays on after starting the engine, the ABS is not working properly.

questions.question: When an engine is running, what is an acceptable oil pressure?

options.text: 10 psi
50 psi
110 psi

questions.explanation: Good oil pressure is between 35 and 75 psi. Do not drive if your oil pressure is low, dropping, or changing.

questions.question: When you start a vehicle, the oil pressure should:

options.text: Slowly build up over a few minutes
Reach normal pressure within a few seconds
Start high, then decrease as the engine runs

questions.correctAnswerText: Reach normal pressure within a few seconds
questions.explanation: Oil pressure should reach normal within seconds after you start the engine.

questions.question: When making a tight turn, a CMV driver should:

options.text: Drive as fast as a car driver would
Not worry about speed, just watch the road
Brake early and slow down gradually to warn drivers behind

questions.correctAnswerText: Brake early and slow down gradually to warn drivers behind
questions.explanation: Drivers behind you may not expect your CMV to slow down for a turn. Brake early and slow down gradually to warn them.

questions.question: A shut-off valve is:

options.text: A device that stops air from leaving an air brake system
A replacement for a pintle hook
Another name for a glad hand

questions.correctAnswerText: A device that stops air from leaving an air brake system
questions.explanation: Shut-off valves control air flow between trailers. The rear shut-off valve should always be closed to keep air in the braking system.

questions.question: When backing up and following a turning trailer, you should:

options.text: Not change anything. The vehicle will naturally follow the trailer
Change the direction of the steering wheel
Turn the steering wheel even harder in the same direction

questions.correctAnswerText: Change the direction of the steering wheel
questions.explanation: When backing with a trailer, first turn the steering wheel in the opposite direction of the turn. Once the trailer starts turning, reverse the steering direction to follow it.

questions.question: When driving in hot weather:

options.text: Air pressure in tires will decrease
Engine oil helps keep the engine cool
Antifreeze is not needed

questions.correctAnswerText: Engine oil helps keep the engine cool
questions.explanation: Keep enough oil in your engine and enough water and antifreeze in your cooling system to prevent overheating. Antifreeze is important in both hot and cold weather.

questions.question: When backing, you should:

options.text: Move quickly to get out of other drivers' way
Try not to use the mirrors
Use a helper if possible

questions.explanation: Backing is dangerous because you cannot see everything behind your vehicle. Use a helper to watch your blind spots whenever possible.

questions.question: When driving a vehicle with an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), you should:

options.text: Pump the brakes several times before pressing hard on the pedal
Brake normally
Press the brake pedal as hard as possible every time you slow or stop

questions.explanation: Brake the same way in a vehicle with ABS as you would in one without ABS. ABS automatically activates to prevent wheel lockup when needed.

questions.question: The more alcohol in the body:

options.text: The faster the liver digests the alcohol
The less effect the alcohol has
The longer it takes to remove the alcohol from the body

questions.correctAnswerText: The longer it takes to remove the alcohol from the body
questions.explanation: The body removes alcohol at a fixed rate. More alcohol means it takes longer for your body to remove it.

questions.question: When driving, mirrors should be used:

options.text: Only when there may be a problem
Not very often
Often

questions.explanation: You must know what is around your vehicle at all times. Check your mirrors regularly while driving.
